meta.name: api-ai-claude-vision
meta.description: Image understanding and document analysis with Claude's multimodal capabilities -- image input formats, PDF processing, multi-image patterns, structured extraction, and token cost estimation

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用Claude视觉能力分析图片和文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用AI理解图片或文档内容
copy.tagline_en: Analyze images and documents with Claude's vision
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need AI to understand images or documents

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能看懂图片和 PDF 里的文字、图表、表格，并提取信息。你可以把图片或 PDF 直接发给它，它会描述内容或按你的要求提取结构化数据。
howto.when: 当你需要分析图片（如截图、图表、收据）或处理 PDF 文档（如提取文字、总结）时触发。支持多张图片对比和结构化提取。

say.text: 描述这张图片里有什么。
从这张收据图片中提取商家、日期、商品和总金额。
say.note: Claude 会按结构化格式返回数据。

say.text: 比较这两张图片的差异。
say.note: Claude 会对比并列出不同之处。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can understand text, charts, tables in images and PDFs, and extract information. You can send images or PDFs directly to it, and it will describe the content or extract structured data as requested.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to analyze images (e.g., screenshots, charts, receipts) or process PDF documents (e.g., text extraction, summarization). Supports multi-image comparison and structured extraction.

say_en.text: Describe what is in this image.
say_en.note: Claude will describe the image content.

say_en.text: Extract merchant, date, items, and total from this receipt image.
say_en.note: Claude will return data in a structured format.

say_en.text: Compare the differences between these two images.
say_en.note: Claude will compare and list differences.
